name: Flow of Mana raises Intellect and Strength by 5% then 10% (#1116)
contract: Flow of Mana rank 1 704604 and rank 2 680758 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passives) each carry two SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE (137) effects: effect 0 EffectMiscValue 3 (Intellect) and effect 1 EffectMiscValue 0 (Strength), EffectBasePoints 4 (rank 1) and 9 (rank 2) with DieSides 1 -> +5% and +10%, matching the tooltips 'Increases your Intellect and Strength by 5%.' and '... by 10%.'. Nothing in the module or SQL touches either id. Native path: AuraEffect::HandleModTotalPercentStat (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4491) sets the stat's TOTAL_PCT modifier to the product of all 137 effects and calls UpdateStatBuffMod, and the stat is stored as an integer. The stat metric returns Unit::GetStat, an integer field, so every reading truncates. To keep truncation from swallowing the percentage, the Intellect check first adds a known +100 with Arcane Intellect 36880 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT Intellect, EffectBasePoints 99 -> +100, self-target, 30 minutes) and the Strength check adds +100 with TEST 100 STR DND 24653 (aura 29 Strength, EffectBasePoints 99, permanent), both to all three fixtures via set_aura; the stat is then at least 100, so truncation moves the ratio by less than 0.01. The three fixtures are the same race, class and level; the control has neither rank, 'rank1' knows 704604 and 'rank2' knows 680758 (a rank replacement: one talent row with two spell ids). Expected ratios to the control: 1.05 and 1.10 on both stats, asserted in bands 1.04-1.06 and 1.09-1.11.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Add a known +100 Intellect to the control
Add a known +100 Intellect to rank 1
Add a known +100 Intellect to rank 2
Add a known +100 Strength to the control
Add a known +100 Strength to rank 1
Add a known +100 Strength to rank 2
Control Intellect includes the +100 fixture buff
